title: Check a supplier invoice before you pay it
context: You approve supplier invoices. Check each one against its purchase order and delivery record.

steps.question: Does the invoice match the order?
What do you do?
options: Hold it and ask the supplier for a corrected invoice

steps.reason: Same items, quantity and price as the order. If any of them differed, the supplier would have to correct the invoice first.
The record shows all 20 chairs. If some were missing, you would pay only for what arrived.
Both checks passed, so you pay the full $1,700.
Same items, quantity and price as the order.
The invoice matches the order, so you pay $320 for the 8 cartridges that arrived.
The invoice charges $240 a desk. The order says $220.
The price is wrong, so the supplier corrects the invoice before you pay anything.
